about: Alert rule cases both engines must agree on (QV-627). Written by make-alerts-parity.py; see that file.

toneOf.name: a rule with only below set
warn only, at the limit: not over
crit under warn: crit wins when both are passed
crit under warn, between them: critical
below: at warn is not under

diff.name: nothing before, nothing now
first seen OK: stored, nothing sent
first seen firing: fired from nothing
stays critical: not sent again, since kept
OK to warning: fired
OK to critical: fired
warning to critical: changed
critical to warning: changed
critical to OK: resolved
a firing rule deleted: dropped, no longer checked
an OK rule deleted: dropped without a message
a warning rule deleted: no longer checked
no figure for one check: kept as it was, nothing sent
the figure back, still critical: the same incident
the figure back and OK: resolved
no figure, 1 ms short of the limit: still kept
no figure for the whole limit: dropped, no longer checked
an Alert me rule gone: dropped without a message
same widget ID on two dashboards
the order of now is kept
every: new messages while already firing: fired again, since kept
every: still firing with no new messages is not sent
quiet: new messages while already firing: not sent again

causeRule.name: the first check only notes what is there
the first check of an every rule: nothing sent
every: new messages fire
every: none new resolves
quiet: new after the quiet period fires
quiet: new inside the quiet period does not
quiet: new while firing stays firing
quiet: no new, inside the period, still firing
quiet: no new, the period over, resolves
quiet: the period counts as over 5 min early
quiet: 1 ms short of the slack is not over
quiet: new exactly at the early end fires
quiet: no new, never fired, stays OK
a message that left the cause is not new
seen but no lastNewAt: counts from now
30 min quiet, in minutes
7 days quiet
muted: worked out as usual, muted said
muted forever
a snooze that ends now is over
the cause gone: the rule's own label, nothing seen
error texts merged into one group: still the rule's cause
a rule on the merged group matches the texts split again
two groups of equal size: the first names it
a merge only joins exception groups
capped read, inferred group
